# Follow or Bounce
> Personal site of D.V. — engineer and designer. Writing on technology and
> consciousness, maintained reference tools, and Follow or Bounce, a one-person
> studio for AI, agentic systems, and the web. Based in Honolulu, Hawaii.

## Sections

- https://followorbounce.com/ — Home
- https://followorbounce.com/work/ — Work: client and studio projects
- https://followorbounce.com/writing/ — Writing: essays and interactive pieces
- https://followorbounce.com/reference/ — Reference: maintained guides and tools
- https://followorbounce.com/offers/ — Offers: services (AI, agentic, advisory, web)
- https://followorbounce.com/about/ — About
- https://followorbounce.com/brand/ — Brand identity guide
- https://followorbounce.com/contact/ — Contact

## Offers (commercial)

- Custom agents & automations — task-specific agents and automated workflows.
- AI integration for existing products — assistants, RAG/search, extraction.
- Technical advisory & audits — architecture, model selection, eval and cost work.
- Static sites & interactive builds — one-page sites and long-scroll editorial.
